import sys, json, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from kt import *

FAIL = []
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAIL.append(name)
        print("FAIL", name)
        print("  got ", json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True))
        print("  want", json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True))
    else:
        print("ok  ", name)

def raw_cli(payload):
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", CLI], input=payload,
                          capture_output=True)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        return {"exit": proc.returncode, "stderr": proc.stderr.decode()[:800]}
    try:
        return json.loads(proc.stdout.decode())
    except Exception as exc:
        return {"unparsable": proc.stdout.decode()[:400]}

# ------------------------------------------------------------ invalid input
bad_inputs = {
    "duplicate key": b'{"types": [], "types": []}',
    "nan": b'{"types": [], "x": NaN}',
    "infinity": b'{"types": [], "x": Infinity}',
    "huge float": b'{"types": [], "x": 1e400}',
    "malformed": b'{"types": [',
    "trailing json": b'{"types": []} {"types": []}',
    "empty": b'',
    "not json": b'hello',
    "invalid utf8": b'{"types": [], "x": "\xff\xfe"}',
    "array root": b'[]',
}
for name, payload in bad_inputs.items():
    check("invalid input: " + name, raw_cli(payload), {"error": "INVALID_INPUT"})

# valid but minimal
check("valid minimal", raw_cli(b'{"types": [], "modules": [], "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": [], "machine": null, "runs": []}'),
      {"plans": [], "records": [], "corpus": []})

# ------------------------------------------------------------ module order
types = [{"name": "N", "kind": "int", "bits": 32}, {"name": "Flag", "kind": "bool"}]
def mod(name, requires=None):
    return {"name": name, "params": [["n", "N"]], "result": ["r", "Flag"],
            "requires": requires}
mods = [mod("aaa"), mod("bbb"), mod("ccc"), mod("root")]
calls = [["root", "aaa"], ["root", "bbb"], ["bbb", "ccc"]]
camp = {"types": types, "modules": mods, "calls": calls, "pipes": [],
        "entries": ["root"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
out = run(camp)
check("module order", out['plans'][0]['modules'], ["aaa", "ccc", "bbb", "root"])

# ---------------------------------------------------------- multiple entries
mods = [mod("alpha"), mod("beta")]
runs = [{"entry": "alpha", "ktest": ktest([("x0", u(1, 4)), ("x1", b"\x01")])},
        {"entry": "beta", "ktest": ktest([("x0", u(1, 4)), ("x1", b"\x01")])},
        {"entry": "alpha", "ktest": ktest([("x0", u(1, 4)), ("x1", b"\x00")])}]
camp = {"types": types, "modules": mods, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
        "entries": ["alpha", "beta"], "machine": None, "runs": runs}
out = run(camp)
check("plan order", [p['entry'] for p in out['plans']], ["alpha", "beta"])
check("records", [(r['status'], r.get('case')) for r in out['records']],
      [("READY", 0), ("READY", 1), ("DUPLICATE", 0)])
check("corpus entries", [(c['entry'], c['inputs'], c['witnesses']) for c in out['corpus']],
      [("alpha", {"n": 1}, [0, 2]), ("beta", {"n": 1}, [1])])

# ------------------------------------------------------------------- void
types2 = [{"name": "N", "kind": "int", "bits": 32},
          {"name": "Nothing", "kind": "void"}]
mods2 = [{"name": "main", "params": [["n", "N"]], "result": ["r", "Nothing"],
          "requires": None}]
runs = [{"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest([("x0", u(5, 4))])}]
camp = {"types": types2, "modules": mods2, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["main"],
        "machine": None, "runs": runs}
out = run(camp)
check("void slots", out['plans'][0]['slots'], [["x0", ["n"], 4]])
check("void variables", out['plans'][0]['variables'], 1)
check("void result", out['records'][0]['model_result'], None)
check("void status", out['records'][0]['status'], "READY")

# ------------------------------------------------------------- char and enum
types3 = [{"name": "C", "kind": "char"},
          {"name": "E", "kind": "enum", "values": ["red", "green"]},
          {"name": "Flag", "kind": "bool"}]
mods3 = [{"name": "main", "params": [["c", "C"], ["e", "E"]],
          "result": ["r", "Flag"], "requires": None}]
runs = [{"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest([("x0", b"\xe9"), ("x1", u(1, 4)), ("x2", b"\x01")])}]
camp = {"types": types3, "modules": mods3, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["main"],
        "machine": None, "runs": runs}
out = run(camp)
check("char slots", out['plans'][0]['slots'], [["x0", ["c"], 1], ["x1", ["e"], 4], ["x2", ["r"], 1]])
check("char corpus", out['corpus'][0]['inputs'], {"c": "é", "e": "green"})

# enum index out of range
runs = [{"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest([("x0", b"a"), ("x1", u(5, 4)), ("x2", b"\x01")])}]
camp["runs"] = runs
out = run(camp)
check("enum out of range", out['records'][0]['status'], "INVALID_TEST")

print()
print("FAILURES:", FAIL if FAIL else "none")
PYEOF
